hunks.old: A Faucet can draw untagged fluid from a Casting Tank into a Table or Basin. The source's saved data must match both live container slots; source, Faucet and target are staged together, and a changed source comparator is notified after a successful write. When a packet is reserved from the source, a waiting source container is processed on staged data; the source slots are published only after the combined write succeeds. The source, target, current recipe and Faucet are rechecked after processing. Already-reserved untagged fluid can finish if the source container fills the source with tagged fluid, but a new tagged reservation waits. Other destinations remain unsupported. Unknown data waits. Actual host integration, game, save/reload, LAN and disk/network atomicity remain unverified.
hunks.new: A Faucet can draw untagged fluid or a registered vanilla base-potion fluid from a Casting Tank into a Table or Basin. Base-potion packets retain the exact potion tag; a different potion with the same fluid ID cannot mix. The source's saved data must match both live container slots; source, Faucet and target are staged together, and a changed source comparator is notified after a successful write. When a packet is reserved from the source, a waiting source container is processed on staged data; the source slots are published only after the combined write succeeds. The source, target, current recipe and Faucet are rechecked after processing. A safe already-reserved packet can finish if the source container fills the source with different tagged fluid. New base-potion reservations use the current casting recipe; custom colors/effects, unknown potion IDs and other tagged forms still wait. Other destinations remain unsupported. Unknown data waits. Actual host integration, game, save/reload, LAN and disk/network atomicity remain unverified.
